Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Canadian swimmer (born 1931) Eric Jubb Personal information Born ( 1931-01-17 ) 17 January 1931 (age 95) Toronto , Ontario, Canada Sport Sport Swimming Eric MacGregor Jubb (born 17 January 1931), later known as Eric Lamont , [ 1 ] is a Canadian former backstroke and freestyle swimmer .
